title: Premium Flyer Award of Summit Upgrade Certificates
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program adds a premium-flyer award to a choice-benefit certificate issue according to the coupons the member flew in the First cabin in the last twelve months, as the flown coupons of the member's tickets under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter record the cabin flown.

1. 4 or more coupons flown in the First cabin: 2 certificates added.
2. 1 up to fewer than 4 such coupons: 1 certificate added.
3. No such coupon: no premium-flyer award.

Only coupons flown in the First cabin count; Premium Economy coupons do not. A coupon counts when its flight date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day of the issue.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical counts).** 3 First coupons add 1 certificate; 4 add 2; 0 add none.
